meta.title: Vendor GST Mismatch Validation: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Tenant plan and feature entitlement state for a lower-plan tenant versus a Growth tenant
Signing in as an AP Executive on both tenants
Opening and using Vendor GST Mismatch Validation
Creating or inspecting an invoice whose GST differs from the vendor master GST
Observing the lower-plan refusal or absence and the Growth-plan successful validation
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Tenant plan and feature entitlement state for a lower-plan tenant versus a Growth tenant; Signing in as an AP Executive on both tenants; Opening and using Vendor GST Mismatch Validation; Creating or inspecting an invoice whose GST differs from the vendor master GST; Observing the lower-plan refusal or absence and the Growth-plan successful validation

args.need: sign in as an AP Executive on a tenant below Growth and on a Growth tenant, run Vendor GST Mismatch Validation with an invoice GST that differs from the vendor master GST, and report whether the capability is absent or refused below Growth and works on Growth

steps.note: The tester must perform the unavailable plan-gated invoice and vendor-master GST workflow across both tenant plans.
Confirm the session has no crash or server error after the tester completes the requested workflow; this does not assert the plan-gating behavior.
